action_proposals.description: Squeeze the dough first along the Y-axis, then rotate 90 degrees and squeeze along the X-axis. Both squeezes are centered on the dough.

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the gripper from its initial position to a location directly above the center of the blue playdoh.
Correct the initial small angle of the gripper to perfectly align its jaws parallel to the X-axis for a squeeze along the Y-axis.
Lower the gripper to the specified pre-grasp height of z=0.257m.
Perform the first compression on the dough along the Y-axis.
Open the gripper to release the dough after the first squeeze.
Rotate the gripper 90 degrees to prepare for the second, perpendicular squeeze along the X-axis.
Perform the second compression on the dough along the X-axis to form a block shape.
Release the final shaped dough.

action_proposals.description: Squeeze the dough first along the X-axis, then rotate -90 degrees and squeeze along the Y-axis. The grasp is slightly off-center for a varied result.

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the gripper to a position slightly off-center from the dough along the x-axis to introduce variation.
Rotate the gripper by approximately 90 degrees to align its jaws parallel to the Y-axis for the first squeeze along the X-axis.
Lower the gripper to the specified pre-grasp height of z=0.257m.
Perform the first compression on the dough along the X-axis. A slightly wider grasp width is used for diversity.
Open the gripper to release the dough after the first squeeze.
Rotate the gripper -90 degrees to prepare for the second, perpendicular squeeze along the Y-axis.
Perform the second compression on the dough along the Y-axis to form a block shape.
Release the final shaped dough.

action_proposals.description: Shape the dough by squeezing it along two perpendicular diagonal axes (45 and 135 degrees).

action_sequence.reasoning: Move the gripper from its initial position to a location directly above the center of the blue playdoh.
Rotate the gripper to a 45-degree angle relative to the world axes for the first diagonal squeeze.
Lower the gripper to the specified pre-grasp height of z=0.257m.
Perform the first compression on the dough along a 45-degree diagonal.
Open the gripper to release the dough after the first squeeze.
Rotate the gripper 90 degrees to prepare for the second squeeze along the perpendicular diagonal (135 degrees).
Perform the second compression on the dough along the 135-degree diagonal to form a block shape.
Release the final shaped dough.
